verdict.rationale: Fireflies runs some work autonomously in the background: its bot can auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize, and it delivers notes and action items after every meeting. Admins get a Rules Engine, but it is scoped to meeting access and privacy. Broader user-defined automations depend on webhooks and external tools like Zapier, not a native general-purpose automation builder. Missing for 10: native user-configurable workflow/automation builder beyond admin privacy rules, documentation of trigger/action options for scheduled or agentic background tasks, independent hands-on corroboration.
